import re, math
from pprint import pprint

# 1) Parse Amazon items from the Simple Note we identified earlier
super_pw = {p['account_name']: p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
simple_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='deniseburch@gmail.com', password=super_pw['simple_note'])['access_token']
amz_token = apis.amazon.login(username='deniseburch@gmail.com', password=super_pw['amazon'])['access_token']

note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=simple_token, note_id=3084)
content = note['content']

items=[]
for line in content.splitlines():
    line=line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    m=re.match(r'^[-*]\s*(\d+)\s*quantity\s*of\s*(.+)$', line, flags=re.I)
    if m:
        qty=int(m.group(1))
        name=m.group(2).strip()
        items.append({'requested_name': name, 'requested_qty': qty, 'source_line': line})

print('Parsed list items:', len(items))
for it in items:
    print(it)

# 2) Criteria enumeration gate (for our own logging)
print('\nTASK:', "Reset my amazon cart to have as many products in as many quantities from this list as available, and tell me its total cost. Total cost includes tax but not delivery fees")
criteria = [
    ('From note', "include products from this list", "use simple_note note_id=3084 parsed quantities"),
    ('Available only', "only include the available items", "for each note item, add min(requested_qty, inventory_quantity); skip if inventory_quantity<=0 or no matching product"),
    ('Cart reset', "Reset my amazon cart", "clear_cart then add selected products"),
    ('Tax included', "include tax", "compute base_cost + tax from show_cart after adding"),
    ('Delivery excluded', "not delivery fees", "exclude delivery_fee from total calculation")
]
print('Criteria table:')
for c in criteria:
    print(c)

# 3) Search Amazon products for each list item (paginate fully)

def normalize(s):
    s = s.lower().strip()
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', s)
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s).strip()
    return s

all_matches = {}
for it in items:
    q = it['requested_name']
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    results=[]
    while True:
        resp = apis.amazon.search_products(query=q, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        # normalize results
        if isinstance(resp, dict):
            page = resp.get('products') or resp.get('results') or resp.get('items') or []
        else:
            page = resp
        if not page:
            break
        results.extend(page)
        if len(page) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    all_matches[q] = results
    print(f"\nSearch '{q}' returned {len(results)} products")
    # show first few candidates for visibility
    for r in results[:5]:
        print(' -', r['product_id'], r['name'], 'inventory', r.get('inventory_quantity'))

# 4) Select best matching product per note item

def name_match(req, cand_name):
    reqn = normalize(req)
    candn = normalize(cand_name)
    if not reqn or not candn:
        return False
    if candn == reqn:
        return 'exact'
    if reqn in candn or candn in reqn:
        return 'partial'
    # word overlap heuristic
    req_words = set(reqn.split())
    cand_words = set(candn.split())
    if req_words and (len(req_words & cand_words) / len(req_words)) >= 0.7:
        return 'fuzzy'
    return False

selected=[]
for it in items:
    req = it['requested_name']
    req_qty = it['requested_qty']
    cands = all_matches.get(req, [])
    scored=[]
    for r in cands:
        cand_name = r.get('name','')
        m = name_match(req, cand_name)
        if not m:
            continue
        inv = r.get('inventory_quantity', 0) or 0
        inv_int = int(math.floor(inv))
        scored.append((m, inv_int, r.get('price',0) or 0, r.get('rating',0) or 0, r))
    # prioritize exact > partial > fuzzy
    priority = {'exact':3,'partial':2,'fuzzy':1}
    scored.sort(key=lambda x: (priority[x[0]], x[1], x[3], -x[2]), reverse=True)

    if not scored:
        selected.append({
            'requested_name': req,
            'requested_qty': req_qty,
            'status': 'not_found'
        })
        continue

    # take top candidate, but ensure it's available
    top = scored[0][4]
    inv_int = int(math.floor(top.get('inventory_quantity',0) or 0))
    qty_to_add = min(req_qty, inv_int) if inv_int>0 else 0

    selected.append({
        'requested_name': req,
        'requested_qty': req_qty,
        'matched_product_id': top['product_id'],
        'matched_product_name': top.get('name'),
        'matched_status': scored[0][0],
        'inventory_quantity': inv_int,
        'qty_to_add': qty_to_add
    })

# Print verification table
print('\nSelected products (pre-add):')
for s in selected:
    print(s)

# Summarize which will be added
to_add = [s for s in selected if s.get('qty_to_add',0) and s['qty_to_add']>0]
print('\nWill add count:', len(to_add))
print('Add payloads:', [(x['matched_product_id'], x['qty_to_add']) for x in to_add])
